name: hall_ruin
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. A grounded ruined goblin chieftain hall foundation. Broken broad timber beams and a collapsed brick-red canvas roof, crooked broken goblin banner still attached to a short post, cold stone hearth at the center and fallen door. No intact standing hut, no flames, no crown, no floating timbers. Low broad rubble silhouette whose left and right limits sit on the same ground baseline.
